Just Eats With Chef JJ - Quick and Easy BBQ

Chef JJ shows off for Rapper Freeway with a quick and easy BBQ meal that you can prepare indoors. He lays out BBQ brisket sliders, smokey baked beans, and simple coleslaw that helps bring the BBQ feel right into your home.
Just Eats With Chef JJ - Dinner for 2

In this episode, it's all about dinner for 2, and Chef JJ lays out a great meal that's perfect for any dinner date. He starts with tender and juicy pork chops and gravy served with collard greens and roasted baby potatoes.
New Soul Kitchen - Asian Flavors

It's all about Asian flavors; chef cooks up general Tso's shrimp with jasmine rice; then puts his spin on Buddha's delight, serving it up with chicken and beef; he wraps things up with a citrus Saketini.
New Soul Kitchen - Etouffee It
Chef smothers his dishes in gravy and for those who don't know, that's called étouffée; on the menu, chicken and sausage étouffée over linguine; smothered pork chops with rice and okra.
Culture Kitchen - Grilling It Up Baby

This episode is all about delicious grilled meals with Caribbean inspired flavors. First it's super simple marinated grilled chicken and shrimp kebobs served over couscous, then it's Caribbean seasoned skirt steak And shrimp with rice And beans.
Culture Kitchen - Flan Friday

On this episode Bren shows us a cultural family favorite dessert. It's all about the flan! First she lays out a caramel glazed pumpkin spiced flan, then she moves onto a shaved coconut flan infused with a dash of rum.
Living by Design - Kela

Jake and Jazz give Kela a glamorous redesign in her bedroom. Jake creates a mirror, while Jazz adds to the glamour with soft shades of pink. The reveal meal is sea bass and potatoes and a rose water, orange flavored cake.
Living by Design - Dr. Bobbi

It's all about a space for relaxation, Jake makes a modernized day bed for meditation and Jazz brings tranquil vibes with plush pillows, and relaxing colors. On the menu is spicy penne pasta and cinnamon roll sticky cake.
